body.translated_text: <s>Mahāmaṇivipulavimānaviśvasupratiṣṭhitaguhyaparamarahasyakalparājadhāraṇī</s> (The Dhāraṇī of the King of Rituals, the Supreme Secret of the Hidden, Well-Established in All, of the Great Jewel and Vast Celestial Palace)

body.text:
GBM 1724 (fol. 53r)
1 yitavyāḥ || dvātṛṃśati śarāvā pūrayitavyāḥ || catvāri tailāni catvāri ghṛtaṃ | catvāri
2 guḍapiṇḍāni | catvāri tilapūrṇāni | catvāry aṭhalapūrṇaṃ | catvāri saptavījakapūrṇaṃ
3 nānābaliḥ kartavyaḥ bhakṣyaveṣṭimakapūpamudgapūpatilapūpa | aśokavarti

children.translated_text: balls of molasses (<s>guḍapiṇḍa</s>s), four filled with sesame, four filled with <s>aṭhala</s> (rice-flour cakes), four filled with seven-seed [mixture].

children.text:
lāvaṇaṃ
4 ghṛtagarjakaṃ guḍapūpaṃ sarvasukṛtakāryāṇi yathā lābhaṃ saṃjñātavyaṃ
5 maṇḍalakaṃ suracitaṃ kṛtvā tato praveśadvāreṇa gatvodakapūrṇaṃ dvau kalaśausthāpya
children.translated_text: Various offerings (<s>bali</s>) are to be made: cakes wrapped in food-offerings, bean-cakes, sesame-cakes, <s>aśoka</s>-wicks,

body.translated_text: ...are to be filled. Thirty-two bowls (<s>śarāva</s>s) are to be filled. Four [vessels of] oil, four [of] ghee, four

children.text: lābhaṃ ca baliṃ sthāpya tathāvat praveśavidhiṃ ca kārayet tataḥ anena mantreṇābhi
children.translated_text: ghee-cake, molasses-cake — all meritorious acts are to be understood according to availability. Having made a well-drawn <s>maṇḍala</s> (ritual diagram), then entering through the entrance-door, having placed two water-filled ritual vessels (<s>kalaśa</s>s),

children.text:
cya
2 praveśayet* oṃ maṇi vipula supratiṣṭhita siddha abhiṣiṃca māṃ sarvatathāga
children.translated_text: and having placed the offering (<s>bali</s>) according to availability, one should perform the entrance rite accordingly. Then, having consecrated (<s>abhiṣiñcya</s>) with this <s>mantra</s>,

children.text:
bhiṣekai
3 bhara bhara saṃbhara hūṃ hūṃ || yathābhiṣiktamātraś ca sarvāṇi nivaraṇā
children.translated_text: one should cause [the initiate] to enter: <s>Oṃ maṇi vipula supratiṣṭhita siddha abhiṣiṃca māṃ sarvatathāga</s>-

children.text: 4 pūrvajanmasaṃjātāni karmāvaraṇāni vuśuddhāni bhavanti bhavanti sarvaśuddhaparigṛhito bha
children.translated_text: <s>tābhiṣekai bhara bhara saṃbhara hūṃ hūṃ</s>. As soon as one is thus consecrated, all the obstructions (<s>nivaraṇa</s>s),
the <s>karmāvaraṇa</s>s (karmic obstructions) arising from previous births, become purified. One becomes embraced by all purity,

body.text:
GBM 1726 (54r)
1 sarvasiddhiś cābhyāmukhībhavati | yaṃ cintayati yaṃ prārthayati tat tathaiva karoti ||
body.translated_text: blessed by all <s>Tathāgata</s>s (Buddhas), consecrated by all <s>Tathāgata</s>s, comforted by all <s>Tathāgata</s>s.

children.translated_text: Having entered into the <s>samaya</s> (vow) of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s, following the <s>dharmatā</s> (true nature) of all <s>Tathāgata</s>s, [being one who has]

children.text:
kṣānti
3 pratilabdhaḥ bodhimaṇḍopasaṃkramaṇo bhavati | evam ādīni
4 guṇaviśeṣāṇi pratilabhate | yāvad avaivartiko bhaviṣyati | anuttarā bo

children.translated_text: attained the <s>kṣānti</s> (patient acceptance) of the profound <s>Dharma</s>, one becomes one who approaches the seat of enlightenment (<s>bodhimaṇḍa</s>). Thus and in other ways
one attains special qualities. One shall become irreversible (<s>avaivartika</s>). [This is] the fulfillment of the path to supreme enlightenment (<s>anuttara bodhi</s>).

body.translated_text: All <s>siddhi</s>s (accomplishments) become favorable. Whatever one contemplates, whatever one desires, that he accomplishes exactly so.
The ritual procedure for the <s>maṇḍala</s> (sacred diagram) — the third chapter (<s>paṭala</s>) of the ritual procedure.

body.text:
GBM 1727 (54v)
1 athāto mudrālakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye | catvāri mahāhṛdayamudrāṇi prayojyā sarvatathāgataiḥ
2 kulasāmānyaṃ prayojayet* || catvāry āryavajrahṛdayamudrāṇi upayojyā sarvamaṇḍa
body.translated_text: Now I shall declare the characteristics of the <s>mudrā</s>s (ritual hand-gestures). Four great heart-<s>mudrā</s>s are to be employed [as prescribed] by all <s>Tathāgata</s>s. One should employ [them] as common to [all] families (<s>kula</s>s). Four noble <s>vajra</s>-heart-<s>mudrā</s>s are to be employed with all <s>maṇḍala</s>s.

children.text:
kule
4 mudrā upayojyā yathāvidhi || bāhyamudrā na grahetavyā : anyamudrā yathā
5 sukhaṃ sarvatra upayoktavyaḥ yathā upayujyate tathāgatakule || oṃ sarvatathāga
children.translated_text: family is the <s>mudrā</s> to be employed according to the prescribed method. The outer <s>mudrā</s> should not be taken; another <s>mudrā</s> should be employed everywhere as one pleases, just as it is employed in the <s>Tathāgata</s> family. <s>Oṃ sarvatathāga</s>-
<s>tahṛdaya</s>-

body.translated_text: The reassurance-<s>mudrā</s> (<s>āśvāsanamudrā</s>): [joining] equally the outer hand[s and] another <s>mudrā</s>, one should begin. This very [gesture] in the <s>Tathāgata</s>

body.text:
GBM 1728 (55r)
1 maṇijvālani āreṣṭaya hūṃ || tathāgatahṛdayamudrā : || oṃ sarva

children.text:
thāgata
2 pravarāgramaṇi hūṃ || tathāgatasamayamudrā : || oṃ sarvatathāgatābhi
children.translated_text: <s>tathāgata pravarāgramaṇi hūṃ</s>. The <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>samaya</s>-<s>mudrā</s> (vow-gesture). <s>Oṃ sarvatathāgatābhi</s>-

children.text: bodhanavajre 3 hūṃ hūṃ || tathāgataāśvāsanamudrā || oṃ sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhā
children.translated_text: <s>saṃbodhana vajre hūṃ hūṃ</s>. The <s>Tathāgata</s> reassurance-<s>mudrā</s>. <s>Oṃ sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhā</s>-

children.text:
4 maṇi maṇi hūṃ hūṃ phat* || tathāgatādhiṣṭhānamudrā || oṃ sarvatathāgata pravara maṇi
5 rucire hūṃ hūṃ phat* || tathāgatavajrasiṃhāsanamudrā || oṃ sarvatathāgata vipula saṃbha
children.translated_text: <s>na maṇi maṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ</s>. The <s>Tathāgata</s> empowerment-<s>mudrā</s> (<s>adhiṣṭhānamudrā</s>). <s>Oṃ sarvatathāgata pravara maṇi rucire hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ</s>. The <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>vajra</s>-lion-throne-<s>mudrā</s>. <s>Oṃ sarvatathāgata vipula saṃbha</s>-

body.text:
GBM 1729 (55v)
1 hūṃ hūṃ || tathāgatābhiṣekamudrā || oṃ sarvatathāgata samaya maṇi vajre hūṃ hūṃ ||
body.translated_text: <s>ve hūṃ hūṃ</s>. The <s>Tathāgata</s> consecration-<s>mudrā</s> (<s>abhiṣekamudrā</s>). <s>Oṃ sarvatathāgata samaya maṇi vajre hūṃ hūṃ</s>.

body.text: 2 dharmacakramudrā : || oṃ sarvatathāgata jaya ajitavajre hūṃ hūṃ || aparājitamudrā || oṃ sa

children.text:
tathāgatadharmadhātu
3 mahāmaṇi śikhare hara hara hūṃ hūṃ || tathāgatacakravartimu
children.translated_text: <s>tathāgatadharmadhātu mahāmaṇi śikhare hara hara hūṃ hūṃ</s>. The <s>Tathāgata</s> world-sovereign-<s>mudrā</s> (<s>cakravartimudrā</s>).

body.translated_text: The <s>Dharmacakra</s>-<s>mudrā</s> (wheel-of-the-law gesture). <s>Oṃ sarvatathāgata jaya ajitavajre hūṃ hūṃ</s>. The unconquered-<s>mudrā</s> (<s>aparājitamudrā</s>). <s>Oṃ sarva</s>-

body.text:
4 oṃ sarvatathāgata vajrā hvaya ddhara dhara hūṃ hūṃ phat* || āryavajramaṇigrahaṇamudrā : |
5 oṃ dhuru dhuru maṇi mahāvidyuta maṇi svāhā || cintāmaṇimudrā āryavajrasya mudrā || oṃ loka

children.translated_text: <s>pālite</s>

body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ sarvatathāgata vajrā hvaya ddhara dhara hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ</s>. The noble <s>vajra</s>-jewel-grasping-<s>mudrā</s>. <s>Oṃ dhuru dhuru maṇi mahāvidyuta maṇi svāhā</s>. The <s>cintāmaṇi</s>-<s>mudrā</s> (wish-fulfilling jewel gesture), the <s>mudrā</s> of the noble <s>Vajra</s>. <s>Oṃ loka</s>-

body.text:
GBM 1730 (56r)
1 jaya jaya hūṃ hūṃ || caturmahārājānāṃ mudrā grahetavyā : || oṃ vipulā gravati
2 saṃbhara hūṃ || śriyā mahādevyā mudrā grahetavyā || oṃ daṃṣṭriṇi visara hūṃ || tarjanīmu

children.text: 3 śaṃkhinī || oṃ āgamaya dhīra mucāṭṭa hāsinī hūṃ dūtīmudrā baddhitavyā : || oṃ sa
children.translated_text: (<s>tarjanīmudrā</s>) of <s>Śaṅkhinī</s>. <s>Oṃ āgamaya dhīra mucāṭṭa hāsinī hūṃ</s>. The messenger-<s>mudrā</s> (<s>dūtīmudrā</s>) is to be bound.

children.text:
ntākāra
4 paripūraṇe dhaka dhaka hūṃ hūṃ phat* maṇḍalanivāsinīnāṃ mudrā : || ābāhana
children.translated_text: ...form. In completion [the mantra]: <s>dhaka dhaka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ</s>. The <s>mudrā</s> (seal/gesture) of those dwelling in the <s>maṇḍala</s> (sacred circle). The <s>ābāhana</s> (invocation)
<s>mu</s>-

5 grahetavyā : || oṃ sara sara visara hūṃ hūṃ padmamudrā || mudrāvidhāna caturtho paṭa
children.translated_text: -<s>drā</s> (gesture) should be taken. <s>Oṃ sara sara visara hūṃ hūṃ</s> — the <s>padmamudrā</s> (lotus-gesture). The <s>mudrā</s>-arrangement (mudrāvidhāna), the fourth chap-

in detail.

body.translated_text: <s>jaya jaya hūṃ hūṃ</s>. The <s>mudrā</s> of the four great kings (<s>Caturmahārāja</s>s) is to be taken. <s>Oṃ vipulā gravati saṃbhara hūṃ</s>. The <s>mudrā</s> of <s>Śrī Mahādevī</s> (the great goddess of fortune) is to be taken. <s>Oṃ daṃṣṭriṇi visara hūṃ</s>. The threatening-finger-<s>mudrā</s>
